findings: The east-bank transition changed but did not remove the central visible smooth earth face. It remains a failed visual candidate.

The first R07 ray(.755,.72) fell on a side-bank edge and was incomplete diagnosis. Rays placed using the actual detail-frustum coordinates(.66,.70)/(.68,.75) directly hit the central earth face atz=-14.46/-14.666.

The water/terrain path actually terminates and narrows atz=-15, making a visible transverse earth plug. R09 therefore extends the physical waterbed into a genuine through-arch in the rear support base, rather than concealing this plug with vegetation.
